answer.headline: Chain Hook pulls Winston out of a jump.
reasons: Roadhog into Winston: Chain Hook pulls Winston out of a jump and Scrap Gun burst kills him before Barrier helps.
No visible enemy hard-counters Roadhog.
answer.how_to_play: Take cover angles, hook whoever is isolated and Compactor their burst. Main target: their Winston.

answer.headline: Into their Wrecking Ball: Chainguns crit and burn melt Adaptive Shield.
reasons: Mauga into Wrecking Ball: Chainguns crit and burn melt Adaptive Shield.
Fits your team: pairs with Kiriko.
answer.how_to_play: Push into their frontline, keep both guns on them and Overdrive in the brawl. Main target: their Wrecking Ball.

answer.headline: Into their Mauga: Defense Matrix eats his Incendiary Chaingun fire.
reasons: D.Va into Mauga: Defense Matrix eats his Incendiary Chaingun fire, so he cannot build burn or Overdrive lifesteal.
No visible enemy hard-counters D.Va.
answer.how_to_play: Matrix their key projectiles, boost onto their backline and peel your supports. Main target: their Mauga.

answer.headline: Chainguns and armour out-sustain Doomfist burst.
reasons: Mauga into Doomfist: Chainguns and armour out-sustain Doomfist burst.
No visible enemy hard-counters Mauga.
answer.how_to_play: Push into their frontline, keep both guns on them and Overdrive in the brawl. Main target: their Doomfist.

answer.headline: Their Zarya counters Orisa: Bubbles soak Energy Javelin and Fusion Driver damage.
reasons: Orisa loses to Zarya: Bubbles soak Energy Javelin and Fusion Driver damage, so Orisa's poke charges Zarya.
Reinhardt is even into their Zarya, so that duel stops deciding the fight.
Fits your team: pairs with Shion, Ana.
answer.how_to_play: Walk them back with Barrier up, swing when they close and save Charge for a pin.

answer.headline: Into their Mauga: Defense Matrix eats his Incendiary Chaingun fire.
reasons: Roadhog loses to Mauga: Incendiary Chaingun burn eats Roadhog's huge unarmoured health and outlasts Take a Breather.
D.Va into Mauga: Defense Matrix eats his Incendiary Chaingun fire, so he cannot build burn or Overdrive lifesteal.
answer.how_to_play: Matrix their key projectiles, boost onto their backline and peel your supports. Main target: their Mauga.

answer.headline: You win the Roadhog matchup.
reasons: Zarya into Roadhog: A bubble soaks the Chain Hook combo damage.
Domina is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
answer.how_to_play: Bubble your tank or yourself on their burst and charge up before you fight. Main target: their Roadhog.

answer.headline: Into their Hazard: Accretion stuns him out of Violent Leap.
reasons: Sigma into Hazard: Accretion stuns him out of Violent Leap and Experimental Barrier blocks Downpour from above.
Safe into their Bastion: Barrier Field and Kinetic Grasp soak Assault configuration fire.
Fits your team: pairs with Sojourn.
answer.how_to_play: Barrier their poke, Grasp their key projectile and Accretion the peekers. Main target: their Hazard.

answer.headline: Beats their Winston.
reasons: Not Mauga: their Ana hard-counters it (Ana's Biotic Grenade shuts off Mauga's self-healing).
Doomfist has no self-sustain for Ana's anti-nade to shut off.
answer.how_to_play: Punch in on isolated backliners, block poke with Power Block and get out on Slam.

answer.headline: Into their Sigma: Particle Cannon beam cannot be absorbed by Kinetic Grasp.
reasons: Zarya into Sigma: Particle Cannon beam cannot be absorbed by Kinetic Grasp.
Zarya into Widowmaker: Bubbles protect allies from Widowmaker headshots.
Zarya gives their Widowmaker a smaller or shielded target.
answer.how_to_play: Bubble your tank or yourself on their burst and charge up before you fight. Main target: their Sigma.

answer.headline: Hammer swings hit Venture as she surfaces from Burrow at melee range.
reasons: Reinhardt into Venture: Hammer swings hit Venture as she surfaces from Burrow at melee range.
Nothing else they have hard-counters Reinhardt.
answer.how_to_play: Walk them back with Barrier up, swing when they close and save Charge for a pin. Main target: their Venture.

answer.headline: You win the Hanzo matchup.
reasons: Zarya into Hanzo: Bubbles absorb Hanzo's burst and Zarya gains charge.
Doomfist is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
Watch the Ashe: Out-ranges her beam from high ground.
answer.how_to_play: Bubble your tank or yourself on their burst and charge up before you fight. Main target: their Hanzo.

answer.headline: You win the Junkrat matchup.
reasons: D.Va into Junkrat: Defense Matrix eats Frag Launcher grenades and Concussion Mines.
Mauga is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
answer.how_to_play: Matrix their key projectiles, boost onto their backline and peel your supports. Main target: their Junkrat.

answer.headline: You win the Reaper matchup.
reasons: Junkrat into Reaper: Frag spam and Steel Trap punish Reaper's walk-in long before his shotguns reach you.
Junkrat is already even or better into their Sojourn; a swap only trades ult charge for a paper edge.
answer.how_to_play: Spam the choke from cover, trap the flank route and mine away from divers. Main target: their Reaper.

answer.headline: Into their Genji: Fire burn keeps ticking through Deflect.
reasons: Anran into Genji: Fire burn keeps ticking through Deflect and fans out-trade him at close range.
Ashe loses to Genji: Genji's Deflect sends Ashe's shots straight back.
Anran can fight back when Genji dives.
answer.how_to_play: Flank wide, Inferno Rush onto isolated backliners, keep Dancing Blaze to escape. Main target: their Genji.

answer.headline: Into their Genji: Fire burn keeps ticking through Deflect.
reasons: Anran into Genji: Fire burn keeps ticking through Deflect and fans out-trade him at close range.
Widowmaker loses to Genji: Genji dives Widowmaker on an off-angle with no escape.
Anran can fight back when Genji dives.
answer.how_to_play: Flank wide, Inferno Rush onto isolated backliners, keep Dancing Blaze to escape. Main target: their Genji.

answer.headline: You win the D.Va matchup.
reasons: Ramattra into D.Va: Ravenous Vortex pulls D.Va out of flight.
Zarya is only a soft counter here; not worth losing ult charge on a swap.
Watch the Torbjörn: Torbjörn melts Ramattra's big hitbox.
answer.how_to_play: Poke in Omnic form, then go Nemesis when they commit and punch through shields. Main target: their D.Va.

answer.headline: No matchup here is worth a swap.
reasons: D.Va is already even or better into their Orisa; a swap only trades ult charge for a paper edge.
D.Va is even into their Orisa, and nobody on their team hard-counters you.
answer.how_to_play: Matrix their key projectiles, boost onto their backline and peel your supports.
